sources.title: GitHub - ace-step/ACE-Step: ACE-Step: A Step Towards Music Generation ...
sources.snippet: 📝 Abstract We introduce ACE-Step, a novel open-source foundation model for music generation that overcomes key limitations of existing approaches and achieves state-of-the-art performance through a holistic architectural design. Current methods face inherent trade-offs between generation speed, musical coherence, and controllability.

Key Features 💰 Commercial-Ready: Unlike many models trained on ambiguous datasets, ACE-Step v1.5 is designed for creators.

sources.title: ACE-Step 1.5: Pushing the Boundaries of Open-Source Music Generation
sources.snippet: 📝 Abstract 🚀 We present ACE-Step v1.5, a highly efficient open-source music foundation model that brings commercial-grade generation to consumer hardware. On commonly used evaluation metrics, ACE-Step v1.5 achieves quality beyond most commercial music models while remaining extremely fast— under 2 seconds per full song on an A100 and under 10 seconds on an RTX 3090.
